ops.entry: WHEN grading a class-scoped criterion from a receipt DO first read what its own disclosure and the signed gaps say it omits; grade met only if the receipt or a census reaches every class member, else partial naming the unsampled states. A ruling prescribing that evidence does not widen it.
ops.why: Two consecutive goal-check cycles graded a class criterion met from a receipt that the brief's own gaps (and in the second cycle my own note) said sampled only illustrations; both grades were superseded by measured counterexamples in the unsampled remainder. P-03/P-04/P-05/P-13/P-14 did not stop it: none ties the verdict to receipt reach. Displaces P-12, the weakest Pattern: its ask-before-choosing-reserved-contract rule is already carried by the handoff skill's decide-or-ask scoping (changes to scope or approved contracts always go to the operator).

originals.original: WHEN a task turns an explicitly unresolved operator-facing contract into implementation requirements DO retain only the settled contract or obtain the missing ruling before signature; otherwise the plan silently chooses an observable behavior the operator reserved.
